failIf: important near-camera object is accidental primitive-only geometry
important near-camera object is billboard-only unless StyleProfile explicitly requires it
key surface is uniform flat material without explicit StyleProfile justification
style requires dynamic/emissive lighting but source has no measurable effect on nearby 3D geometry
scene is predominantly a few large undetailed primitive surfaces without explicit StyleProfile justification

regressionTargets.expectation: must fail KRIEGER_CLASS when represented by boxy primitive-dominant geometry without semantic secondary detail/material/light evidence

styleRule: StyleProfile controls appearance; quality tier controls execution depth. Intentional minimalism/voxel/watercolor must be judged by style-equivalent semantic and artistic complexity rather than forced PBR.
kriegerRule: Krieger is a technological quality floor and source of general reusable principles, not an art-style mandate and not permission to copy protected assets/designs.
nextExecutableStep: Implement a deterministic scene-metrics collector for primitive dominance and semantic-detail coverage, then make bridge-chamber-v1-class a negative KRIEGER_CLASS regression fixture.
retentionRule: Every confirmed reusable capability or quality lesson must link to exact SHA/evidence and enter Knowledge Base/Capability Registry; repeatable operations become playbooks; affected knowledge becomes NEEDS_REVERIFY.
